items.note: K1a states the lemma (signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), scratch restored, bit and Gaussian-dyadic versions), and K1a.1-K1a.6 follow the proof at 741-765: rows cancel old scratch, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, y<-y+x, then the three stages. The gate maps are never defined, and h=100 and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are not given.

K1b and its sub-steps reproduce the invariant 'stored = D_v applied to logical array', the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise linear gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} including auxiliary roles, as at 804-825.

The statement is right: comparable nondegenerate labels, only central 3->4 edges decrease (by h), sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, orthonormal residual bases, and ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation gives the forms, the terminal sums, the stage transitions, the telescoping and the orthonormal-basis argument. It omits the eight-time gate-label table (975-988) and the residual table (1021-1043) that verify nesting edge by edge, and K1c.4 only restates the lemma.

K1V1 assigns P_U to gates/sinks and -P_{U_a} to X_a and states s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m with endpoint difference I_m. Its sub-steps follow 1156-1171: nested projections have rank equal to dimension change, the N source edges (2P_{U_a}) are exceptions of rank one, the deficit is N-2L_b, and P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. K4.2 uses the shear frames Phi_M.

The frame C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and the kernel derivation (weight additivity mod 4, odd weight, phase identity, 1232-1259) are present. The endpoint half (1273-1314) is only asserted in T2a.0b. The plan omits that zero and full labels have frames I and C^{tensor m}, and that the X_a->Y_a route gives C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, fixed by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}.

s<Wm for both networks follows from L<N/2 (deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c). The plan states tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} and justifies it as at 1331-1343: deficits above 20*2^{-50}, m<2^{20}, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta). The exact eta values are not given.

Individual primitives are used: cyclic row split into W streams, split/merge at a bit, single-bit moves, controlled shifts for triangular updates (later field from earlier fields). Neither lemma is stated as a result with its conditions (fixed radix, O(V) list, offset prepared in b^{O(1)}, rational units prime to q).

K2 states A=E_1 Pi E_2 correctly, but the elimination proof (1375-1392) is not given. K3.1-K3.4 follow the shear proof faithfully: triangular conjugation in O(V), and each one of Pi as one interchange between two controlled shifts. K3 omits the fixed finite matrix collection and the fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators (1396-1397, 1413-1423), which make the rational factors valid mod q^b.

The route matches 1491-1588: cyclic split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} on each edge via matrix shear, the frame identity giving H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows, the three-shear interchange, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the fixed-tape schedule. K's statement omits the hypothesis that a row field before the chunks has length divisible by W^k. It is only implicit in K4.0 and T1's 'with enough rows'.

The paper's proof: top rho=O(log e) digits form a row field q^{2rho}>=W^k, rows padded to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width split into base-m pieces at total O(V e^tau), binary ranges padded to [q^e], and the one-bit unequal-width case.

The steps reproduce the phase identities, the edge product of directional kernels, P_M conjugation to standard coordinates, the inverse child via (-i)^f Z C Z, Gaussian elimination into at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

Follows 2013-2231: the eight conditional additions and their cycles, packed cyclic shifts, guard interval and union bound giving delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting only B, swaps plus rotations, radix-sort repair, cost terms, and application to a change of basis. The separate two-bit XOR at the top position j_{f-1} (2187-2193) is not mentioned.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) for e<d^beta, internal geometric sum, leaf bound and base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}), all as in 2286-2448.

Exact layer, one truncation, O(V d^{lambda'}), error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, and guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) via A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, all following 2450-2586 and the proof 2686-2758. T2's own statement leaves K=floor(d^c) and the parameter bands implicit (they appear in PC.3 and T2.1-T2.2).

Character cancellation, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed order B_t, the reversed procedure, the grouped round H then J_E, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, per-round cost, the single-truncation error argument, and the exact operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, all as in the paper.

B_0=2^{4p}, evaluation bounds, separation |h_j|<B_0/2, two's-complement packing, centered extraction, real/imaginary streams, negacyclic reduction and the final truncation to Q_p(fg/r), as in 3233-3368.
Normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), and the error chain 2delta, 2delta+eta, 3delta+eta, M(3delta+eta), with cost O(Tp[...+log(rp)]), as in 3414-3495.

The derivation follows 3576-3679 and 3836-3897: maps S,T, nearest-index selection, the HvdH identity and estimate, Neumann inversion, normalized contractions, ordered numerical maps, tensoring, d p^2 error and O(d^2) axis moves. The coordinate permutations (P_s u)_j=u_{tj} and (P_t v)_k=v_{-sk} that the identity keeps are never defined.

Both identities are stated. The sub-steps follow the proof: chirp periodicity, coefficient comparison, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, R F^+ R=F^+, the normalized convolution rule and conjugation. The exponent identity in T6a's method is misstated (see errors), but T6a.2 has the right coefficient.

Fixed rationals, layer inequalities, sizes, comparison constants, alpha and gamma, the prime-interval lemma with eta=1/(4d), disjoint intervals, Bernoulli bound T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the prime search cost, and no wraparound with c_j<2^{3b}, all as in the paper.

Algebra isomorphism, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, padding scan, update order d..1, bijection on the padded box, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and O(d^2) unequal-width swaps for O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)), as in 4204-4296.

The exact twist (well defined, diagonal, isometric, wrap sign cancelled) and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are stated and derived. The computed procedure at 4349-4413 is not described: approximate phases theta~^{+/-} with error <2*2^{-p}, the sequence f', g', h', untwist, and the width normalization. It is only reflected in ER1.3's 'two input twist errors... output untwist error', each <4.

Chirp transform, source transform F~ with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A=RF_s, conjugate opposite procedure, digit scaling 2^{-b-2}, the six steps, and the role of the two scales by S, as in 4415-4544.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, <6TL, <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, 2E_s+2, 3E_s+2, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, and the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, then rounding and carries, as in 4546-4806. ER1.1 misplaces E_ring relative to the scale M (see errors).

Table rows, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2 kappa, the row derivations, setup and exceptional-sort costs o(V), absorption of fixed powers of log p, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in 4808-4995.

R lists schonhage-strassen-conjecture and limits-and-limit-inferior as prerequisites. No step states that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 negates the eventual n lg n lower bound, or that the power saving gives limit zero.

errors.says: With the form x^T(I-J/9)y over Q (resp. the dot product over F_2) one has <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 and <t_T,t_T>=2.
errors.paper: These values hold for the rational form only. Over F_2 with the dot product t_T.t_T=1 (and t_S.t_T=|S cap T| mod 2), and that is what makes neighboring (even-intersection) lines orthogonal in the complex construction.

errors.says: Method: compare coefficients of u_k 'using the identity j^2-(j-k)^2-k^2=2jk-2k^2+...' so that only exp(2 pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i) survives.
errors.paper: The coefficient is (1/T) conj(a_j) a_{j-k} conj(a_k), whose exponent combines j^2-(j-k)^2+k^2=2jk exactly. The plan's combination with -k^2 would leave a -2k^2 term.

errors.says: The ring convolution before the scale M has error E_ring:=M(3L+2)<5TL.
errors.paper: Before the multiplication by M the error is less than 3L+2. E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL is the error of the returned normalized convolution after that multiplication.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route. K1 goes network, frames, nested labels, rank equals dimension change, L<N/2, s<Wm, tau=1-2^{-50}. That feeds the power-width interchange (K, with the Bruhat shear and the recurrence) and its general-width extension T1. The complex interface feeds the simultaneous layer T2, and T3-T6, MA, ER and TB carry it to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out without breaking in four places: the network's parameters h=100, N and m are never fixed; the gate-label and residual tables that verify nesting are omitted; the complex endpoint telescoping (C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates) is only asserted; and the factorization lemma is stated without its elimination proof.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) on three-element-subset banks with all scratch restored is fully given. The required parameters are absent: h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, so 'bank size N' and the label dimension m stay undefined. Conservative verdict, since the table requires them.
Common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the motivation that only endpoint frames matter, so intermediate frames are free to make edges cheap.

Nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional bilinear space built as tensor products of triple-indicator lines over three stages; every edge joins comparable labels; only central-wire edges from time 3 to 4 decrease, each losing h.
P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U^perp and zero on its complement, so its rank is dim V - dim U. The N first edges out of X_a are the exceptions, of rank one, because of -P_{U_a}.
Signed changes telescope to Wm-2N; the Ic decreasing edges of loss h add 2L with L=Ich; hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. The deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m at X_a, 0 to identity elsewhere), so with the frames Phi_M the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
Rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2. It costs exactly a interchanges (each one of Pi as shift, interchange, shift) plus O(V) triangular work, so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} because the deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and log m<20. The geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: 8 of 9 steps reconstructed. The chain from frames, through nested labels, rank equals dimension change, the Wm-2N+2L budget, L/N=100/539 or 101/539, the endpoint identity and edges as recursive interchanges, to the recurrence and tau=1-2^{-50}, is present with its quantities. Only C1 falls short: the exchange network's mechanism is fully given, but h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated.
